title: Restore the historically working translation-only mimic reference during locomotion
current_regressed_contract: f4b0040 replaced the translation-only reference with a full world-to-animation-data rotation of current positions, rotations, and velocities. E73 shows the policy then drives the physical root opposite the shell while Pose Search selects Walk_Left.
hypothesis: During locomotion, rotating live canonical body state into the selected animation-data root frame changes the policy's locomotion semantics. Restoring the historical translation-only reference will preserve working Motion Matching selection while making policy-driven physical root progress follow the shell.
single_behavior_change: Only LocomotionActiveShell uses the translation-only mimic current-reference conversion. BalanceActive_Standing and all activation states keep the existing full world-to-data frame conversion. Future pose sampling, Pose Search query, selected assets, shell path, policy model, action decoding, control gains, and scenario schedule are unchanged.
tdd_contract: Selected world/data root positions resolve the exact historical XY offset.
Translation-only conversion subtracts XY offset and ground height from every body position.
Translation-only conversion preserves all body rotations, linear velocities, and angular velocities exactly.
LocomotionActiveShell selects translation-only conversion; BalanceActive_Standing and denied locomotion do not.
All existing standing, adapter, and locomotion tests remain green.

The authoritative Normal episode retains non-idle Motion Matching selection, positive route-projected physical-root progress, lower final root-shell tracking error than ZeroActions, full readback, support, and clean stop-to-standing.
rejection_rule: Reject and revert if non-idle selection disappears, route-projected progress is nonpositive, Normal final tracking is not lower than ZeroActions, stop-to-standing fails, or standing behavior changes.
next_if_supported: Measure Normal and ZeroActions from the same clean commit, preregister immutable protocol v2 thresholds and score, then run the complete repeated causal bundle.
